mainEntity.name: Can I implement AI Entity Optimization myself, or do I need an expert?

acceptedAnswer.text: While basic schema markup can be implemented with plugins or tools, comprehensive AI Entity Optimization often requires expert knowledge. Identifying all relevant entities, understanding semantic relationships, and correctly implementing advanced schema across a large site can be complex. An expert can conduct thorough entity research, develop a robust schema strategy, ensure proper technical implementation, and provide ongoing monitoring to maximize your AI visibility, saving time and preventing potential errors.
acceptedAnswer.description: While basic aspects can be self-implemented, comprehensive AI Entity Optimization usually requires an expert for complex entity research, schema strategy, and technical implementation.
